landmarks.name: Colosseum (Flavian Amphitheatre)
landmarks.description: The iconic elliptical amphitheatre in the centre of Rome, the largest ever built.

landmarks.name: Arch of Constantine
landmarks.description: Triumphal arch celebrating Emperor Constantine I's victory at the Battle of Milvian Bridge.

landmarks.name: Ludus Magnus
landmarks.description: The largest gladiatorial training arena and barracks in Rome, connected to Colosseum by tunnel.

landmarks.name: Roman Forum
landmarks.description: The vibrant civic, political, religious and commercial hub of ancient Rome along the Via Sacra.

landmarks.name: Temple of Venus and Rome
landmarks.description: The largest known temple in ancient Rome, dedicated to Venus Felix and Roma Aeterna.
